data.title: $1,000 in Bitcoin or XRP: Which Is Worth More by 2030?
data.description: Both coins have slumped this month, but one sits much farther from its peak while the other has a stronger ETF story. Six 2030 scenarios show how a $1,000 bet could split, and why the bigger upside may come with a catch.
